question: What role does the goddess play in breaking the ocean of existence?
premises: She arranges the breaking of the ocean of existence.
She is protected in relation to the breaking of the ocean of existence.
inference: The goddess orchestrates the rupture of worldly existence while remaining safeguarded in that process.
uncertainties: rakṣitā may mean protected or protecting; the exact relation to bheda is ambiguous.
plain_english: She arranges the breaking of the ocean of existence and is protected in the breaking of the ocean of existence.
